headline: Hashim-Affiliated Entities Buy Back Rp4,06 T in Shares, Here's What WIFI Says
summary: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital (WIFI) responded to a Rp4.06 trillion share repurchase transaction between affiliated entities ISB and SGK. The company gave its explanation of the deal.
why: Transactions between affiliated parties in listed Indonesian companies draw scrutiny from investors over governance and related-party dealings. Share repurchases can also affect a stock's supply and price.
original_headline: Entitas Terafiliasi Hashim Beli Balik Rp4,06 T Saham, Ini Kata WIFI
